searchText: Attestation rate dropping Yeah confirmed 76% We got some report on some nodes down from nethermind But all our nodes are fine (At least ones I can access - some issues with accessing log system) Anyone having any issues with Nethermind maybe? not only attestations but missed slots we (Nimbus) were: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/issues/9878 But I don't know if that's related to what's happening here Above one is super weird - not eve a single node of ours (including nimbus one) had that Yeah, will find out more once jakubgs returns later today. Anyway, it's one possibility, to your question Yeah we are thinking what it could be (since Hoodi report) but cannot figure out why Just anecdotally, I've also run Nimbus/Nethermind on both Hoodi and Mainnet and both have worked well We're happy to supply whatever logs or Nethermind databases would be helpful in this regard Just confirming that this is spread across multiple entities. A number of our Prysm nodes are split off: https://forky.mainnet.ethpandaops.io/ Hmmm one user who reports issues shown the logs and this doesn't look like anything on Nethermind side (At least at first glance) but blocks started to be delivered bery very slowly Can this be narrowed down to any particular client pair(s)? We're not seeing it with any EL in particular - its all of them - so unlikely to be an EL issue at this stage Also, people already noticed sometimes slow/late attestations earlier after the fork Block delivery times here - started to be completly outsynced from 12 sec Here started to happen around block 23937064 We have situations were blocks got delivered after 200-400 seconds Are almost all blocks being locally built now? wtf Valid observation failsafe, intentional working as designed 1 buildernet; everything else local it's not really helping in this situation but it shouldn't hurt either Is curious yes, if a certain amount of block misses happen, builder API gets disabled User reporting issues on TG have two nodes on Prysm Mentioned Lighthouse also but I don't get ocnfirmation yet <@&595683609080365088> anyone here? X-Posting: Prysm team is aware: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1445979272421572649/1445983791431684219 We're here we're looking into it right now I've seen it called the circuit breaker, liveness failsfe, etc (the builder API thing) oh ok! thx! e.g., https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/47 that particular version wasn't merged, but that's the idea https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/95 My prysm is running; though I am not staking with it May be better hardweare? You run your ndoe on a beast While weaker setups are affected? Might be because I'm not attesting Mine is not as well and is affected still Builders have come back Participation rising >83% https://notes.ethereum.org/Qcl9AZy6SiWAoTCSwDUTJg?view summary of issues post fusaka Now that we have fusaka behind us, I would like to take devnet 3 offline. Any objections? If no objections raised in the next few hours it will be killed.
